'''Spencer Ball'''<ref name="dt-22226">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22226 New-Age Old-School BHBM v 2 0], DeckTech (Spencer "s_ skywalker" Ball, 18 March 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/22226/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/22226/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010145739/http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/22226/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''s_ skywalker''') posted [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] lists on DeckTech in March 2002.

In 2004 Ball played in Ontario with the Guelph Crew, which he named in October 2004 as himself, [[Andrew Hill]], [[James Sowden]] and [[Kyle Fisher]].<ref name="pcf-4035-55535">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55535#55535 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Nov. 7], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041104184026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55278%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> He played online on CardTable in August 2004.<ref name="pcf-3805-52480">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52480#52480 CardTablers], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041227104522/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52017%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Promoting the 22 August 2004 Toronto tournament, he wrote that the previous Toronto event had drawn 14 players.<ref name="pcf-3824-52585">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52585#52585 Toronto, Ontario - August 22nd], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213115/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52320%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> In October 2004 he called Ontario and the Ice Plains region one of the most active areas for SWCCG in 2004 and hoped the area would hold Ice Plains regionals and Ontario provincials in the coming season.<ref name="pcf-4042-55077">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55077#55077 Worlds 2005], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041031162316/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55081%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> According to his forum signature (captured January–February 2005), he was "#1 in Ontario", and in February 2005 he wrote that the Guelph Crew had won every tournament in 2004.<ref name="pcf-4439-60559">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60559#60559 Michigan mini-open?], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015411/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60324%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-4411-61452">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=61452#61452 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Feb. 13], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050223221905/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60673%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> His forum signature (captured June 2006) read "2005 Ontario Provincial Champion".<ref name="pcf-9009-123901">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=123901#123901 The waiting is over.......Y4 Regional 2006 Info is here!], Spencer Ball (s_ skywalker), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 February 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095832/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9009&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref>
